cues.text: You sit with Fuuka in the open-air corridor behind the school building, a bento box she has made between you.
You eat a mouthful from the bento, your face tightens in pain, and you hunch forward, elbows on your knees.
Fuuka jumps up and runs off. She comes back with water, you drink it down, and she sits beside you again, her head lowered.
